title: Puzzles
statementMd:
Barney lives in country USC (United States of Charzeh). USC has $*n*$ cities numbered from $1$ through $*n*$ and $*n* - 1$ roads between them. Cities and roads of USC form a rooted tree (Barney's not sure why it is rooted). Root of the tree is the city number $1$. Thus if one will start his journey from city $1$, he can visit any city he wants by following roads.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/16add04d27215be96cc1bd1730d1e3a97322e28f.png)

Some girl has stolen Barney's heart, and Barney wants to find her. He starts looking for in the root of the tree and (since he is Barney Stinson not a random guy), he uses a *random DFS* to search in the cities. A pseudo code of this algorithm is as follows:

```
let starting_time be an array of length n
current_time = 0
dfs(v):
	current_time = current_time + 1
	starting_time[v] = current_time
	shuffle children[v] randomly (each permutation with equal possibility)
	// children[v] is vector of children cities of city v
	for u in children[v]:
		dfs(u)
```

As told before, Barney will start his journey in the root of the tree (equivalent to call `dfs(1)`).

Now Barney needs to pack a backpack and so he wants to know more about his upcoming journey: for every city $*i*$, Barney wants to know the expected value of `starting_time[i]`. He's a friend of Jon Snow and knows nothing, that's why he asked for your help.

## Input

The first line of input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of cities in USC.

The second line contains $*n* - 1$ integers $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} < *i*$), where $*p*_{*i*}$ is the number of the parent city of city number $*i*$ in the tree, meaning there is a road between cities numbered $*p*_{*i*}$ and $*i*$ in USC.

## Output

In the first and only line of output print $*n*$ numbers, where $*i*$-th number is the expected value of `starting_time[i]`.

Your answer for each city will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.
statementZhMd:
Barney 生活在 USC（Charzeh 合众国）。USC 有 $*n*$ 座城市，编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$，以及连接它们的 $*n* - 1$ 条道路。USC 的城市和道路构成一棵有根树（Barney 也不知道它为什么是有根的）。这棵树的根是编号为 $1$ 的城市。因此，如果从城市 $1$ 出发，他可以沿着道路到达任意城市。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/16add04d27215be96cc1bd1730d1e3a97322e28f.png)

某个女孩偷走了 Barney 的心，Barney 想找到她。他从树根开始寻找，并且（因为他是 Barney Stinson，而不是什么普通人）使用 *随机 DFS* 搜索这些城市。该算法的伪代码如下：

```
let starting_time be an array of length n
current_time = 0
dfs(v):
	current_time = current_time + 1
	starting_time[v] = current_time
	shuffle children[v] randomly (each permutation with equal possibility)
	// children[v] is vector of children cities of city v
	for u in children[v]:
		dfs(u)
```

如前所述，Barney 将从树根开始他的旅程（等价于调用 `dfs(1)`）。

现在 Barney 需要准备一个背包，因此他想进一步了解即将开始的旅程：对于每座城市 $*i*$，Barney 想知道 `starting_time[i]` 的期望值。他是 Jon Snow 的朋友，什么都不懂，所以向你寻求帮助。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——USC 中城市的数量。

第二行包含 $*n* - 1$ 个整数 $*p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} < *i*$），其中 $*p*_{*i*}$ 是树中编号为 $*i*$ 的城市的父城市编号，也就是说，USC 中编号为 $*p*_{*i*}$ 和 $*i*$ 的城市之间有一条道路。

## 输出格式

在输出的唯一一行中输出 $*n*$ 个数，其中第 $*i*$ 个数是 `starting_time[i]` 的期望值。

对于每座城市，如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则会被判定为正确。
